note: Canonical top three behavior (GSD parity decision D-13; spec gsd-taskmanager/tasks/spec-top-three.md). The web repo is the authority: gsd-taskmanager/tests/fixtures/cross-platform/top-three-corpus.json. Byte-identical copies belong at gsd-iosapp/GSDKit/Tests/GSDModelTests/Fixtures/top-three-corpus.json and gsd-android/core/model/src/test/resources/fixtures/cross-platform/top-three-corpus.json, and every suite runs every case. A task field left out takes the model's default: not urgent, not important, not completed, savedAt, dueDate, focusDate, and focusRank null, createdAt and updatedAt 2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z, location active. location isn't a task field: the test keeps only active rows before calling the function, because archived and trashed rows live in their own stores and no selector reads them. windowDays null means escalation is Off, and escalation itself is pinned by escalation-corpus.json. Today is the local date of now in zone. focusDate is compared as text with that date. In pullMerge the current contract is 4, focus_date and focus_rank are first read at 4, and saved_at is first read at 3. A stored version below a field's first-read version makes that field copyable; a null stored version counts as below every version. tombstoned means a local archive or trash row exists and the remote isn't strictly newer than it. In pushFocus, current is the task's row in the active store when the queue item drains, and omit means both keys stay off the wire. If behavior changes, change the spec, this file in all three repos, and all three implementations together.
